Privacy Policy

Effective 24 October 2026

Thai Sprout (“we”, “us”) is developed and operated by the studio OceanAds. It is a Thai alphabet app for children aged about 6–8, used together with a parent or other grown-up. This policy explains what we collect when a grown-up signs in, why, and the choices you have.

1. Who signs in

Thai Sprout can only be used after a grown-up signs in with Google or LINE. The account belongs to that adult. Children should not create or sign in to accounts by themselves, and we do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children.

2. What we collect

  • From Google sign-in: your Google account ID, name, email address (if verified) and profile picture link.
  • From LINE sign-in: your LINE user ID, display name and profile picture link. We do not request your email address from LINE.
  • Learning progress: which letters have been written and found in the game, which islands have woken up, the hint language, the last letter opened, and the order of quiz cards (so the same arrangement does not repeat).
  • A sign-in cookie that keeps you signed in for up to 60 days, and a short-lived cookie (10 minutes) that protects LINE sign-in from forgery.

3. What we do not collect

  • Drawings stay on the screen for the visit and are never uploaded or saved.
  • Speaking practice uses your device’s built-in dictation. Apple processes that audio under its own terms and may send it to Apple’s servers. Thai Sprout never uploads or keeps recordings.
  • No advertising, no analytics or tracking tools, and we never sell personal information.

4. How we use it

Only to sign you in, show your name and picture in the app, and save and restore learning progress across your devices. Progress is also kept in your browser so the app works offline.

5. Services we rely on

  • Google and LINE (LY Corporation) provide sign-in. Their own privacy policies apply to your accounts with them.
  • Netlify hosts the app and stores account records and progress (servers may be outside your country, including the United States).
  • OpenRouter and Google’s speech model generate the teacher voice. Only fixed lesson scripts are sent; no personal information is included.

6. Keeping and deleting data

We keep your account record and progress while you use Thai Sprout. Signing out removes progress from that device. To delete your account record and all saved progress, email us from the address below with the name on the account and whether you used Google or LINE; we will delete it within 30 days. You can also remove Thai Sprout’s access in your Google or LINE account settings at any time.

7. Security

Connections use HTTPS. Sign-in is verified on our server, sign-in cookies cannot be read by page scripts, and secrets are never sent to the browser. No system is perfectly secure, but we collect as little as we can.

8. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may ask to see, correct, export or delete your data, or object to its use. Contact us and we will respond.

9. Changes

If this policy changes, we will update the date above and, for important changes, show a notice in the app.

10. Contact

隱私權政策

生效日期：2026 年 10 月 24 日

Thai Sprout 由 OceanAds 開發工作室開發與營運（以下稱「我們」），是一款給約 6–8 歲孩子、由家長或其他成人陪同使用的泰文字母學習 App。本政策說明成人登入後我們會收集哪些資料、用途，以及您可以做的選擇。

一、由誰登入

Thai Sprout 須由成人以 Google 或 LINE 帳號登入後才能使用，帳號屬於該名成人。請勿讓孩子自行建立或登入帳號；我們不會在知情的情況下直接向兒童收集個人資料。

二、我們收集的資料

  • Google 登入：Google 帳號 ID、姓名、電子郵件（已驗證者）及大頭貼連結。
  • LINE 登入：LINE 使用者 ID、顯示名稱及大頭貼連結。我們不向 LINE 索取電子郵件。
  • 學習進度：哪些字母已寫過、已在遊戲中找到，哪些小島已甦醒，提示語言、最後開啟的字母，以及測驗卡片的排列（避免連續出現相同排列）。
  • 登入 Cookie：讓您最長保持登入 60 天；另有一個 10 分鐘的短期 Cookie，用來防止 LINE 登入遭偽造。

三、我們不收集的資料

  • 手寫筆跡只在當次使用時顯示，不會上傳或保存。
  • 跟讀練習使用裝置內建聽寫，由 Apple 依其條款處理，可能傳送到 Apple 伺服器；Thai Sprout 不上傳、不保存任何錄音。
  • 沒有廣告、沒有分析或追蹤工具，我們也絕不出售個人資料。

四、資料用途

僅用於登入、在 App 中顯示您的名稱與大頭貼，以及在不同裝置間保存與還原學習進度。進度也會保存在瀏覽器中，讓 App 離線時仍可使用。

五、我們使用的服務

  • Google 與 LINE（LY Corporation）提供登入服務，您在這些服務的帳號適用其各自的隱私權政策。
  • Netlify 代管本 App 並保存帳號紀錄與進度（伺服器可能位於您所在國家以外，包括美國）。
  • OpenRouter 與 Google 語音模型產生老師語音；只會傳送固定的教材文字，不含任何個人資料。

六、資料保存與刪除

在您使用 Thai Sprout 期間，我們會保存帳號紀錄與進度。登出會清除該裝置上的進度。若要刪除帳號紀錄與所有已保存的進度，請以下方信箱來信，註明帳號名稱及使用 Google 或 LINE 登入，我們會在 30 天內刪除。您也可以隨時在 Google 或 LINE 帳號設定中移除 Thai Sprout 的存取權。

七、安全

所有連線皆使用 HTTPS。登入在我們的伺服器端驗證，登入 Cookie 無法被網頁程式讀取，金鑰也不會傳送到瀏覽器。沒有任何系統能保證絕對安全，但我們盡量只收集必要的資料。

八、您的權利

依您所在地的法律，您可以要求查閱、更正、匯出或刪除您的資料，或反對資料的使用。請與我們聯絡，我們會回覆。

九、政策變更

本政策如有變更，我們會更新上方日期；重大變更時也會在 App 內通知。

十、聯絡我們
